sources.title: Newcomer adjustment during organizational socialization: A meta-analytic review of antecedents, outcomes, and methods

concepts.definition: The process by which a new employee learns the role and organization and becomes accepted.

questions.q: Name the three indicators of newcomer adjustment in the 2007 model.
questions.a: Role clarity, self-efficacy and social acceptance.

questions.q: Write one question that improves role clarity in week one.
questions.a: For example: Which three outputs matter most in my first 90 days?
